 UP BOARD EXAM CENTRE LIST 2027 OUT 
 UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 Out: 7,526 Centres, Objection Deadline
 UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 Out: Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) has released the provisional UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 for Class 10 and Class 12 examinations. A total of 7,526 centres have been proposed across the state. Objections against the provisional allotment can be submitted on the official portal until October 28, 2026.  UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 has been released by the Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations. The provisional list includes 7,526 proposed examination centres across Uttar Pradesh. Students, parents and school authorities can check the proposed centre details on the official website, upmsp.edu.in.
 The last date to raise objections against the UP Board Centre List 2027 is October 28, 2026. Applicants must submit their objections online in the prescribed format, with a valid reason and supporting documents. After reviewing the objections, district authorities will process the proposed centre list according to the prescribed schedule.
 For other official updates related to the High School examination, students can check the UP Board Class 10 notification page .

 UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 Released: 7,526 Centres Proposed
 UPMSP has provisionally proposed 7,526 examination centres for the UP Board High School and Intermediate examinations in 2027. This is an increase from the 7,448 centres allotted for the 2026 examinations.
 The proposed centres include government, aided and unaided private secondary schools. The category-wise distribution is given below.
 Students can also check the subject-wise schedules for the UP Board Class 10 Time Table 2027 and the UP Board Class 12 Time Table 2027 to plan their preparation.

 The proposed examination centres have been identified using school-related data verified and updated by tehsil-level committees. The district examination centre determination committees, headed by the respective District Magistrates, will scrutinise the proposed list and consider eligible objections before the process moves forward.
 Important: The list is provisional. Students and schools should check the official UPMSP notice and subsequent updates for changes to the proposed examination centres.
 UP Board Exam Centre List 2027: Objection Last Date
 The last date to submit objections against the provisional UP Board Exam Centre List 2027 is October 28, 2026. Students, parents, principals and school managers can raise objections if they identify an error or have a valid concern regarding a proposed examination centre.
 Objections must be submitted online through the prescribed UPMSP process. Applicants should provide the required school and applicant details, explain the reason for the objection and attach relevant supporting evidence.
 The deadline for the District Inspector of Schools (DIOS) to forward the approved list is November 6, 2026.
 Applicants should complete the objection process before the deadline and retain the relevant submission details for reference.
 Who Can Raise Objections Against the UP Board Centre List 2027?
 The following individuals can raise objections against the proposed UP Board examination centres, subject to the prescribed procedure:
 Students: To report a discrepancy affecting their proposed examination centre.
 Parents: To raise a valid concern regarding the allotted centre.
 School Principals: To report errors in school or centre-related details.
 School Managers: To submit relevant objections with supporting evidence.
 Every objection should clearly explain the issue and include relevant documents wherever required. Applicants should follow the instructions in the official UPMSP notice before submitting their requests.
 Details Required to Submit an Objection
 Applicants should keep the necessary information ready before starting the online objection process. The prescribed objection form may require the following details:
 District name
 Institution name and school code
 Applicant's name and mobile number
 Details of the objection or complaint
 Valid reason for raising the objection
 Relevant supporting documents or evidence
 Applicant's name and signature, as required by the prescribed format
 Applicants should check all details carefully before submitting the objection. Incomplete forms or objections without a clear reason may require further scrutiny under the applicable process.
 How to Check the UP Board Exam Centre List 2027?
 Students and school authorities can follow these steps to check the provisional UP Board Exam Centre List 2027:
 Visit the official website at upmsp.edu.in .
 Look for the notification or link related to the UP Board Exam Centre List 2027.
 Open the relevant examination centre list or notice.
 Check the district-wise or school-wise details available in the published document.
 Find the concerned school's name or code to check the proposed examination centre.
 If a discrepancy is found, read the official objection instructions.
 Submit the objection online in the prescribed format before October 28, 2026, with the required details and supporting documents.
 Students should rely on the official UPMSP website for the published list and any subsequent revisions.

 The detailed subject-wise examination schedule and other examination-related announcements should be checked separately on the official UPMSP website. The proposed centre list does not itself confirm the final examination centre allocation.
 For preparation, Class 10 students can practise using UP Board Class 10 previous-year question papers . Class 12 students can review the UP Board Class 12 syllabus 2026–27 to check subject-wise topics and plan revision.
 Students can also refer to the UP Board Academic Calendar 2026–27 for important academic activities and examination-related timelines.
 UP Board Class 10 and 12 Exams 2027: What Should Students Do Next?
 Students appearing for the UP Board Class 10 and Class 12 examinations in 2027 should check their school's details in the provisional centre list, where available. If an error or concern is identified, they should inform their school authorities and follow the official objection procedure before the deadline.
 Students should also keep track of announcements regarding the final examination centre list, admit cards and the UP Board exam timetable. The final centre details should be confirmed through official board updates and the instructions issued by their schools.
 For exam preparation, students can also review the relevant syllabus and previous-year question papers to understand the examination pattern and practise important topics
